repo.description:
### Impact

Publishing a topic moves it to another category, relists it, resets its dates and permanently deletes the opening post's edit history. Some non-staff users could publish topics they were not allowed to edit:

- On sites that add non-staff groups to `shared_drafts_allowed_groups`, a member of such a group could publish any topic they could read, not only shared drafts. A member who could edit a topic could also turn it into a shared draft, which hid it from everyone outside the group.
- Users allowed to set topic timers, which by default includes trust level 4 users, could schedule a topic they could only read to be published into another category.

In both cases, a topic from a read-restricted category could be moved into a public category and become readable by anyone.

### Workarounds

Remove non-staff groups from the `shared_drafts_allowed_groups` site setting, and remove trust level 4 from the `topic_timers_allowed_groups` site setting.

<!-- patch-triage-lifecycle:7caf7e69f8fece8381d80a21e0756912f5ccdca32f17f69858f28c2143283bb2 -->
repo.summary: Topic publishing lets non-staff users expose restricted topics and erase edit history
